evals.prompt: Add a refreshable status list to apps/gpui-prototype using the existing Sjel capability API. Keep it read-only and use the pinned GPUI version.
evals.expected_output: A GPUI implementation grounded in the prototype's pinned Zed revision, with the endpoint auth reviewed before network integration and UI work kept off the render thread.
assertions: Reads the dependency pin before using GPUI APIs
Does not send credentials to an endpoint without reviewing its auth contract
Moves blocking or asynchronous I/O out of render and click callbacks
Returns results through GPUI-owned state and refreshes the view

evals.prompt: Add Linux support to the standalone GPUI app and verify it builds.
evals.expected_output: The platform feature set is checked against the pinned GPUI revision, Sjel's build toolchain gate is run, and the correct target is compiled without claiming runtime verification from compile success.
assertions: Checks the pinned gpui_platform feature definitions
Enables an appropriate Linux window backend only after checking source
Separates compile success from Linux runtime behavior

evals.prompt: Add a browser-only panel to the Clipper extension.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the GPUI skill does not apply to a browser extension UI.
assertions: Does not use GPUI as the implementation framework for a browser-only UI
Routes to the browser extension's existing framework and conventions
